jobs.prompt: Original narrative painted illustration for Nihility, a modular tabletop RPG book. Images 1–5 are character identity references in this order: Neris (female elf, brown skin, short black braid with silver temples, teal coat, grimoire); Cora (short human woman around fifty, gray bob, olive jacket, instrument case); Ícaro (dark-skinned man, short hair, gray and rust-orange exploration suit, helmet clipped to pack); Lia (young brown-skinned woman, tied curly brown hair, worn red coat, notebook); Doran (short broad male dwarf, gray hair and two short beard braids, ochre wool and leather apron, repaired tools). Preserve their recognizable faces, hairstyles, clothes and relative proportions. All five are adults. Exactly five people, no duplicates. Confident matte acrylic and gouache painting with expressive faces and selective brushwork, readable large silhouettes, natural materials, purposeful details and coherent hands. No glossy CGI, excessive microdetail, purple-gold grading, glowing eyes, runic circles, portals, particle effects, letters, logos, border or generated text. Portrait 2:3 book cover. The five travelers have reached the weathered entrance of an old coastal signal station after rain. Foreground Lia holds the heavy wooden door open and glances back to the others; Doran checks the wooden support beam beside her. Just behind them Cora looks closely at a small simple control panel while Neris holds her closed grimoire and studies the dark doorway. Ícaro stands at the back, helmet at his side, checking the approach from the sea. Clear scene of practical exploration and mutual help, natural asymmetrical composition, gray-blue sea and stone, muted red and teal clothing form the focal points, soft daylight. Leave the top fifth quiet cloud and wall shapes for separately typeset title, bottom tenth relatively quiet. Characters occupy the middle and lower page, no heroic glamour lineup.
